The '''''Skewer''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used by the [[Zorbian space pirates]] in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were rumored to have raided a caravan from [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] that was transporting treasures to be appraised and sold, as well as an [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] antiquities [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], before the pirates crashed on the Forest Moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The ''Skewer'' was equipped with a black market [[transponder]]. A [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] named [[Macy Yakaro]] knew the frequencies the pirates used for their transponder from his time as a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] controller on Annaj, and would charge those who wished to find the ship and its cargo a fee for his help in detecting the various frequencies.
